thread:
maya: Heads up — after enabling strict fncall validation + routing debounce on the canary slice we saw a ~3x uptick in validation rejects and a doubling of fallbacks to the degen model. Not sure if it's misconfig or an interaction with prefix caching.
liam: Ugh. Which debounce window did you flip? could be coalescing hiding partial outputs that strict validator then rejects.
sasha: Debounce window is 200ms in the flag, we also turned on coalescing=true. Did you see specific reject errors in telemetry (schema vs parse)?
maya: Most rejects tagged as `schema_mismatch` and `missing_required_field`. Logs show a bunch of near-duplicate requests where coalescing merged slightly different user prompts.
kevin: That explains it — coalescing + strict validate is brittle when the payloads vary. Options: 1) reduce debounce to 50ms 2) relax validator to soft-fail on missing nullable fields 3) make coalescer preserve field snapshots so validator sees original shape.
anne: For rollout UX we should avoid toggling both flags at once. Can we split the change into debounce-only canary first?
liam: Agreed. We also need to think about billing attribution. Right now fallback->degen still charges primary model tokens in metrics which skews cost dashboards.
sasha: Good call. Propose adding `invoke_path` and `fallback_reason` tags to the fncall telemetry events.
kevin: Also add `route_coalesced=true/false` tag. That will let us filter panels for only coalesced traffic.
maya: Sample telemetry snippet — we can add tags when emitting the `fncall.invoke` event:

```
{ "metric": "fncall.invoke", "tags": ["model=gpt-x", "invoke_path=coalescer->validator->serve", "fallback_reason=schema_mismatch"] }
```

liam: Dashboard needs: stacked panel for `fncall.validation.reject_count` by `fallback_reason`, and a line for `fncall.routing.debounce_hit_rate`. Also histogram of end-to-end latency with breakdown when fallback occurs.
sasha: We should avoid storing full request bodies for retention/compliance. Put a small hash/id in telemetry to correlate logs instead of full payload.
anne: For console UX add a rollup view that groups by `invoke_path` and shows percent fallback, p50/p95 latencies, and cost-per-invoke. Customers hitting fallbacks should show a suggested remediation (reduce debounce / relax nullable rule).
kevin: Implementation plan: revert coalescing on canary for now, change rollout to two flags: `routing.debounce_ms` and `validator.strict_mode`. Canary plan: debounce-only at 10% -> observe 24h -> enable strict_mode at 1% with sampling -> increase. Also add server-side sampling for validator errors to keep noise down.
maya: Sounds good. Can someone own the telemetry tag patch and the dashboard panels? I can take the rollout coordination and config toggles.
liam: I'll take telemetry tags + metric name additions. I'll open PR for `invoke_path`/`fallback_reason` + `route_coalesced`.
sasha: I'll file the dashboard ticket and mock screenshots. Also will add the retention & hash guidance for logs.
kevin: I'll work on coalescer changes so it can optionally preserve snapshots for validator. Will try to keep it behind a flag `coalescer.preserve_snapshots`.
anne: Deploy-bot — can we back out coalescing from prod-canary now?
deploy-bot: scheduled rollback of flag `coalescer.enabled` on prod-canary at 2024-11-12T15:12:00Z. CI: green. Will notify when rolled back.
maya: Thanks. After rollback we'll run debounce-only tests and regroup tomorrow. If telemetry still shows high rejects, we'll flip to soft-validate.
liam: One more ask — add a `fncall.validation.sample_id` so we can link sampled payloads to console examples without leaking content.
sasha: Agreed. We'll add a small sampled artifact store with TTL=7d and access controls.
kevin: Plan LGTM. +1 on staged rollout.
anne: I'll update the runbook with an explicit check: "if fallback_rate > 1% for 1h -> pause rollout".
maya: OK assigning: maya (rollout), liam (telemetry PR), sasha (dashboards + runbook), kevin (coalescer patch). Will follow up in #eng-platform with PR links. :thumbsup:
